itemData.name: Tropical Weather
itemData.description: A brilliant marriage of washed and natural Ethiopian coffees that creates a vibrant cup tasting like candied peach, passion fruit tea, and fresh bergamot. Designed to showcase modern processing clarity with lush fruit sweetness.

tastingLogs.notes: Day 4 post roast: Intense bouquet of jasmine blossoms and ripe stone fruit on the grind aroma. In the cup, crisp Meyer lemon acidity opens up into sweet Georgia peach juice and lingering bergamot tea finish.
Day 8 post roast: Settled in wonderfully! Body has rounded out into silky honey texture. Candied nectarine and black tea finish lasts for minutes.

recipes.title: High Clarity V60 Single-Cup
recipes.notes: Gentle center pours with low agitation to maximize floral nuance and prevent stall.

customVariables.label: Rao Agitation Swirl
customVariables.value: Single gentle swirl at bloom only

steps.title: Bloom
steps.instruction: Saturate all grounds evenly within 10s. Swirl gently once and let bloom degas.

steps.title: First Main Pour
steps.instruction: Pour in steady spirals from center outward up to 150g.

steps.title: Final Pour & Drawdown
steps.instruction: Pour remainder steadily to 250g. One gentle tap to settle bed. Total drawdown ~3:15.

recipes.title: Modern High-Yield Turbo Shot
recipes.grindSize: Coarser espresso (16 clicks Comandante Red Clix)
recipes.notes: Fast 6-bar flow shot that unlocks sparkling fruit notes without harsh astringency.

steps.title: Pre-infusion
steps.instruction: Crack valve for 3s gentle puck saturation.

steps.title: Extraction
steps.instruction: Run pump to 45g yield in cup at ~18-22s.

itemData.name: Chelbesa Village Washed
itemData.description: The archetype of washed Yirgacheffe elegance. Roasted by Brooklyn’s Sey Coffee in their minimalist Nordic profile, this coffee is crystalline, laser-focused, and exudes delicate floral perfumes.

tastingLogs.notes: Resting 2 weeks is essential for Sey. The extraction is now breathtaking: white jasmine blossoms, delicate honeysuckle, and candied Meyer lemon zest. Tea-like silky mouthfeel.

recipes.title: Sey Style High Extraction Pour
recipes.grindSize: Fine-Medium (4.1 on Fellow Ode Gen 2 SSP)
recipes.notes: Near-boiling water required for ultra-dense, ultra-light roasted Ethiopian seed.

steps.title: Bloom
steps.instruction: Wet with 60g boiling water, vigorously swirl 3 times to prevent dry pockets.

steps.title: First Pour
steps.instruction: Pour at 6g/s down the center in gentle circular motions.

steps.title: Second Pour
steps.instruction: Pour out to 275g, gentle stir with glass rod, let drain completely.

itemData.name: Caballero Geisha Washed
itemData.description: Cultivated by the legendary Caballero family in Honduras and roasted by World Barista Champion Tim Wendelboe in Oslo. Pristine floral aromatics accompanied by juicy papaya and lingering elderflower sweetness.

tastingLogs.notes: Absolute masterpiece. Poured into a tulip cupping glass. Explosive tropical perfume of fresh papaya and white blossoms. One of the best Geishas of the decade.

recipes.title: Tim Wendelboe Competition AeroPress
recipes.notes: Classic standard upright method with 3 gentle stirs and a 60s steep.

customVariables.label: Press Duration
customVariables.value: Slow 30 second gentle plunge, stop at hiss

steps.title: Fill & Stir
steps.instruction: Pour 200g water @ 90°C straight in. Stir back and forth 3 times.

steps.title: Second Stir & Plunge
steps.instruction: Stir 3 more times, insert plunger, gently press down for 30s.

itemData.name: Sweetshop Espresso Blend
itemData.description: James Hoffmann’s flagship seasonal espresso blend that rejects traditional dark, bitter espresso in favor of fun, wild, sweet fruit tones like strawberry candies and silky milk chocolate.

recipes.title: Modern Sweetshop 1:2.2 Double Shot
recipes.grindSize: Fine espresso (14 clicks Comandante Red Clix)
recipes.notes: Thick crema, bright strawberry candy pop transitioning into sweet melted fudge.

steps.title: Extraction
steps.instruction: Start timer at first pump sound. First drips at 7s, finish 41g at 28-30s.

itemData.name: Ghost Town Pink Bourbon
itemData.description: An astonishing showcase of thermal shock yeast inoculation. Tastes like pink bubblegum, fresh watermelon soda, and lychee sorbet. An adventure for the adventurous palate.

tastingLogs.notes: Aromatics fill the whole kitchen with strawberry bubblegum and ripe melon. Incredibly sweet and exotic without tasting alcoholic or overly boozy.

recipes.title: Thermal Shock Fruit Bomb Pour Over
recipes.notes: Slightly lower temperature (91°C) preserves delicate aromatic esters and candy sweetness.

customVariables.label: Bypass Water Option
customVariables.value: Add 15g cold mineral water after brew for crisp iced cup

steps.title: Bloom
steps.instruction: Wet grounds with 50g water and let bloom rest for 40s.

steps.title: Main Pour
steps.instruction: Continuous smooth center pour finishing at 1:30. Total drawdown 3:00.

itemData.name: Bella Donovan Blend
itemData.description: The original Blue Bottle blend named after a beloved feline. Rich, dark, comforting, blending African fruit with earthy Indonesian cedar and heavy dark cacao body.

tastingLogs.notes: Deep bittersweet chocolate and jammy blackberry notes. Perfect morning comfort cup with a splash of oat milk.

recipes.title: Full Body French Press Immersion
recipes.notes: Coarse grind, break crust at 4:00, scoop foam, press gently.

customVariables.value: Skim floating crema foam for clean silt-free cup

steps.title: Fill
steps.instruction: Pour all 500g boiling water over grounds. Place lid on top to retain heat.

steps.title: Break Crust & Skim
steps.instruction: Stir surface grounds, skim top foam with two spoons.

steps.title: Plunge & Serve
steps.instruction: Insert filter screen just below water level and pour into warm mugs.

itemData.name: Companion Blend
itemData.description: Companion is Little Wolf's signature year-round blend designed for versatility and approachability. It balances the deep, comforting sweetness of Colombian washed coffees with the bright, floral acidity of Ethiopian heirloom varieties, resulting in a clean and balanced cup.

steps.title: Pre-infusion
steps.instruction: Gentle low-pressure soak

steps.title: Full Extraction
steps.instruction: Extract 36g espresso yield within 26-30s

itemData.name: Apollo
itemData.description: Apollo is a perennial favorite from Counter Culture, designed to showcase the bright, floral, and fruit-forward characteristics of high-elevation Ethiopian coffees. This blend of washed Ethiopian lots offers a clean, tea-like body with vibrant acidity and a complex, aromatic profile.

itemData.name: Sirocco de Sol Geisha
itemData.description: This exceptional Geisha lot from Elkin Guzman undergoes a meticulous experimental process involving a controlled fermentation that highlights the delicate floral aromatics and stone fruit sweetness inherent to the variety. The result is a clean, tea-like cup with a vibrant acidity and a lingering, honeyed finish that showcases the pinnacle of Colombian specialty coffee.

itemData.name: Comandante C40 MK4 Nitro Blade
itemData.settingsNotes: V60: 22-26 clicks. AeroPress: 18-21 clicks. Cupping: 28 clicks. Espresso (Red Clix): 24-28 clicks.
itemData.maintenanceNotes: Burrs brushed after each bag. Seasoned with Grindz tablets every 3 months. Zero clicked at flush handle stop.
itemData.generalNotes: Gold standard hand grinder. Unrivaled unimodal particle distribution and sweetness clarity in washed high-elevation Ethiopians.

equipment.name: Ode Brew Grinder Gen 2 (SSP MP Burrs)

itemData.name: Ode Brew Grinder Gen 2 (SSP MP Burrs)
itemData.settingsNotes: V60 1-cup: 4.1 to 4.3. Chemex: 6.0 to 6.2. Fellow Aiden batch: 5.2. Auto-stop works flawlessly.
itemData.maintenanceNotes: Chute ionizer cleaned bi-weekly with dry brush. Zero calibrated at chirp -1 click.
itemData.generalNotes: SSP Multi-Purpose burrs bring out extreme acidity clarity and juicy stone fruit notes.

itemData.name: Hario V60 Ceramic Dripper 02 (White)
itemData.settingsNotes: Preheat thoroughly with 200ml boiling water. Best with Cafec Abaca or boxed Hario tabless filters.
itemData.maintenanceNotes: Dishwasher safe. Occasional Cafiza soak to remove residual coffee oils.
itemData.generalNotes: The classic cone dripper. The spiral ribs allow uniform air escape and fast bypass when desired.

itemData.name: Stagg EKG Electric Gooseneck Kettle
itemData.settingsNotes: Light roasts: 93°C–96°C. Medium roasts: 90°C–92°C. Dark roasts: 85°C–88°C. Hold temperature active for 60 min.
itemData.maintenanceNotes: Descaled monthly with citric acid solution (1 tbsp per full boil). Never use abrasive pads on the matte finish.
itemData.generalNotes: Precision flow restrictor allows slow 3.5g/sec center pour without turbulent channeling.

itemData.name: Lunar Precision Espresso & Pour Scale
itemData.settingsNotes: 0.1g resolution with auto-tare and auto-timer on flow detection. Bluetooth synced to brew logging.
itemData.maintenanceNotes: Charge via USB-C every 4 weeks. Calibrated with 100g calibration weight every 6 months.
itemData.generalNotes: Water-resistant aluminum anodized chassis. Ultra-fast response time prevents overfilling espresso shots.

itemData.name: Gaggia Classic Pro (9-Bar OPV Mod)
itemData.settingsNotes: OPV spring modified to 9 bar. Preheat 20 minutes with portafilter locked in. Temperature surfing: purge 5s after steam switch flick.
itemData.maintenanceNotes: Backflushed with Cafiza weekly. Group gasket replaced with silicone Cafelat 8.5mm ring.
itemData.generalNotes: True commercial 58mm group. With IMS basket and puck screen, pulls creamy, syrupy double shots.

itemData.name: AeroPress Clear Tritan
itemData.settingsNotes: Standard inverted: 12g fine-medium, 200g water @ 85°C. Stir 20s, steep until 1:30, press 30s.
itemData.maintenanceNotes: Rinse immediately. Rubber plunger stored extended to preserve seal elasticity.
itemData.generalNotes: Indestructible travel companion with crystal clear chamber to inspect bloom clarity.

itemData.name: Aiden Precision Coffee Maker
itemData.settingsNotes: Features customizable brew profiles including 'Single Serve' and 'Batch Brew'. Recommended grind size is medium-coarse (similar to standard drip coffee). Use the 'Bloom' setting for optimal extraction; temperature is adjustable between 176°F and 208°F (80°C–98°C).
itemData.maintenanceNotes: Clean the brew basket and carafe after every use. Descale the machine every 3-6 months depending on water hardness. The showerhead is removable for periodic rinsing to prevent mineral buildup.
itemData.generalNotes: Capacity: 1.5L (50 oz). Features a dual-wall vacuum-insulated carafe, precise PID temperature control, and a bloom cycle. Includes a reusable stainless steel filter and compatible with #4 paper filters. Power: 1500W. Dimensions: 11.7" x 8.5" x 12.2".

itemData.name: Talley Pro Scale
itemData.settingsNotes: Features a dedicated 'Brew Assist Mode' that guides the user through the water-to-coffee ratio process. Offers three modes: Brew Assist, Timer, and Weight. Responsive to 0.1g increments.
itemData.maintenanceNotes: Wipe down with a damp cloth. Do not submerge in water. Ensure the weighing platform is kept clear of debris to maintain sensor accuracy. Battery is rechargeable via USB-C.
itemData.generalNotes: High-resolution OLED display, 2500g capacity, built-in timer, premium stainless steel weighing platform, and a tactile dial for mode selection. Designed specifically for pour-over brewing.

itemData.name: Fellow Opus Grinder
itemData.settingsNotes: Features 41+ settings. For espresso, use the inner ring for micro-adjustments (0-1 range). For pour-over, use the outer ring (1-11 range). Calibration is required via the inner ring adjustment mechanism to ensure zero-point accuracy.
itemData.maintenanceNotes: Clean the catch cup and chute regularly with the included brush. Perform a deep clean of the burrs every 3-6 months. Do not use water to clean the burrs; use a dry brush or specialized grinder cleaning pellets.
itemData.generalNotes: Equipped with 40mm conical C6-2 burrs. Features a 110g hopper capacity, timed auto-stop, and anti-static technology. Voltage: 120V (US model). Build: Plastic body with high-torque motor. Includes a volumetric dosing lid.

itemData.name: Barista Express
itemData.settingsNotes: Integrated conical burr grinder features 18 grind settings. For espresso, start at setting 5-8. Use the 'Grind Amount' dial to adjust dose time. Ensure the pressure gauge stays in the 'Espresso Range' during extraction. If pulling too fast, decrease grind size; if too slow, increase grind size.
itemData.maintenanceNotes: Perform 'Clean Me' cycle when the light flashes using a cleaning tablet. Descale every 2-3 months depending on water hardness. Backflush the group head regularly. Clean the burrs weekly using the provided brush and vacuum to prevent oil buildup.
itemData.generalNotes: 15-bar Italian pump, 1600W thermocoil heating system, 2L removable water tank, 250g bean hopper capacity. Features a manual steam wand, PID temperature control, and stainless steel construction. Includes 54mm portafilter and tamper.

itemData.name: Zerno Z1
itemData.settingsNotes: Stepless adjustment mechanism allows for infinite micro-adjustments. Designed primarily for single-dosing; users typically dial in by sound (chirp point) and adjust based on burr geometry (e.g., SSP 64mm variants). Recommended to calibrate burrs to zero point upon initial setup.
itemData.maintenanceNotes: Tool-less disassembly for easy cleaning of the grind chamber. Burrs should be cleaned periodically with a brush or air puffer. The alignment is factory-set, but the design allows for user-performed alignment checks. Avoid water contact with the motor housing.
itemData.generalNotes: High-precision single-dose coffee grinder featuring 64mm flat burr compatibility. Built with a focus on workflow, low retention, and premium materials (anodized aluminum). Features a variable RPM motor, magnetic catch cup, and integrated declumper. Voltage varies by region; compact footprint.

itemData.name: Sey Coffee
itemData.favoriteDrink: Washed Ethiopian Chelbesa Pour Over & Flat White
itemData.notes: A sanctuary of modern light roast coffee in Bushwick. Skylit, lush greenery, and pour overs brewed on Kalita and V60 with surgical precision.

itemData.name: Tim Wendelboe Coffee Bar
itemData.favoriteDrink: Caballero Geisha & Signature Coffee Shot with Tonic
itemData.notes: The legendary birthplace of modern light roasting. Clean, serene espresso bar where every single coffee is dialed to perfection.

itemData.name: Onyx Coffee Lab (The 1907)
itemData.notes: An absolute coffee paradise built inside an old historic marble building. Under-counter Modbar heads, cold brew taps, and an open cupping lab.

itemData.name: Dayglow Coffee
itemData.favoriteDrink: The Picasso (Espresso, vanilla, tonic & sparkling water)
itemData.notes: The ultimate boutique multi-roaster showcase in Silver Lake. Features rare roasters from across Europe and Japan like DAK, Friedhats, and La Cabra.

itemData.name: Proud Mary Cafe
itemData.favoriteDrink: Ghost Town Thermal Shock & Pour Over Flight
itemData.notes: Quintessential Melbourne specialty institution. Mind-blowing Geshas and thermal shock lots paired with phenomenal Australian cafe fare.

itemData.name: Black Hand Coffee Co.
itemData.notes: A long-standing Richmond institution located in the historic Carytown district. They roast their own beans on-site and offer a wide variety of single-origin coffees and creative blends. The space features a cozy, eclectic interior with plenty of character, making it a popular spot for both locals and visitors.
